title: BOX MODEL
question: What is a layout made of?
note: A zoom-out through layout, cut to the hits of an original track, Pressure Redux. Turn sound on and the song plays; with it off the motion still follows the same hits. The current layer pulses on every kick and snare; on every fourth hit the camera pulls back and the next layer springs out from its edges: padding, border, margin, border-box, block and inline flow, flex items, the container and its axes, basis, grow and shrink, align-self and align-content, a responsive card, and finally the screens it re-flows across. Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom. Seeing each idea literally contain the last makes the vocabulary a single structure instead of a list.
